title: Unassigned pool and auto-grouping
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/lib/teams/auto-group.ts (pure): autoGroup(students, {min:4, max:5}) clusters strictly by course_id. Choose the largest g with 4g <= n and distribute sizes as evenly as possible up to 5; students that cannot fit are returned as leftovers. Deterministic ordering by index number; leader = first by index number. Unit tests for n = 3, 4, 5, 9, 11, 12, 13, 17 and for mixed courses never merging.

src/app/actions/auto-group-students.ts: coordinator or admin; mode 'preview' | 'commit'; pool = students with a users doc in the current year and no active team; commit creates teams with createTeamInTx in transactions (one per team), writes audit team.auto_grouped and notifies members (team_update).

/students gets an 'Unassigned pool' tab: counts per course, list of pooled students, a separate 'not yet signed in' list from the roster, Preview auto-group (groups table + leftovers), Commit with confirm dialog. Button disabled before the formation deadline unless the caller is admin.
Cross-category merging is NOT implemented in v1: the action rejects any request to merge courses.
assumptions: The formation deadline is read from AcademicYearDocument.deadlines (use the existing field); if absent the button is enabled
out_of_scope: Admin transfer, disband and size overrides (12-03)
acceptance: Unit tests pass and no group ever mixes courses
Commit is idempotent: a second run finds an empty pool
Pool and roster tabs stay above their content at 375, 768 and 1280 px
rules: Skip roster students with is_active false (03-03) in the pool and in auto-group
